test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech. Sneha said to me, “I am doing my homework.” **

options.text: Sneha told me that she was doing her homework.
Sneha told me that she had been doing her homework.
Sneha told me that she were doing her homework.
Sneha told me that she has been doing her homework.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Sneha told me that she was doing her homework**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, the verb tense of the reported speech is changed according to the rules of sequence of tenses.
 
• Since the original sentence is in present continuous tense, it is changed to past continuous tense in indirect speech.
 
• 'Am doing' will be changed to 'was doing'.
 
• 'My' will be changed to 'her'.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2** is incorrect as it uses past perfect continuous tense which is not required in this context.
 
• **Option 3** is incorrect as it uses incorrect subject-verb agreement (should be 'was' instead of 'were').
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect as it uses present perfect continuous tense which is not required in this context.
